Risk: High risk of maritime conflict, disruption of global energy supply, regional instability, internal Iranian political divisions.
Title: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps warned that only Tehran-approved routes were valid for commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, defying an Omani plan to reopen the waterway. 'Safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz is only possible via routes announced by the Islamic Republic of Iran,' the IRGC Navy said in a statement carried by Tasnim news agency The move puts the powerful military force at odds with Oman. It also signals deepening divisions within Iran's own post-war establishment
